near_threshold.note: V4 corrects the V3 closure report, which labeled abs(BND) <= .01 as "near_threshold" (2,938); the distance-to-threshold of the flag rule is abs(D_LEP - T) (V3 actual: 2,068 on the frozen ledger).

zero_T.note: A trace row and a benign-reference cell are different units: many LEP traces share one reference cell.  V3's "2,390 zero_T_cells" mixed the two; V4 reports rows and unique reference cells separately.
